lvmh.note: LVMH's organic growth slowed to 1% in Q3 2026 from 3% in Q2 2026, a change of -2 points, and it sits in line with peers, whose median is 0.5%. Asia excluding Japan was the main source, moving from +4% to -5% as management cited a less buoyant China that hit Fashion & Leather Goods, at -5%. Japan at 6%, Europe at 4% and the United States at 5% all grew. Three of four reported regions grew.
lvmh.watch: Check whether Asia excluding Japan and Fashion & Leather Goods return to growth, and whether the other regions keep growing.

hermes.note: Hermès grew 4.3% at constant FX in Q3 2026, down from 6.7% in Q2 2026, a change of -2.4 points. The largest driver was the Americas, where growth moved by -4.9 points to 8.8%. Asia-Pacific excl. Japan was flat at 0, which is 4.3 points below the group rate. Leather Goods and Saddlery grew 10.8%, while Watches fell 6%. Growth remains ahead of the peer median of 0.5%.
hermes.watch: Check whether Asia-Pacific excl. Japan moves off flat and whether the Americas growth rate stabilises after its slowdown this quarter.

kering.note: Kering's comparable growth slowed to -1 in Q3 2026 from 2 in Q2 2026, a change of -3 and 2 points behind the peer median of 0.5. The weakness came from Asia Pacific at -5, where management cited lower store traffic, especially in Mainland China. Kering Fashion & Leather Goods fell -3, with Gucci at -6. Kering Jewelry grew 11 and Kering Eyewear 4. Two of four reported regions grew.
kering.watch: Check whether Asia Pacific and Gucci improve against the tougher base next quarter, and whether Kering Jewelry keeps offsetting weakness in Kering Fashion & Leather Goods.

richemont.note: Richemont grew 13% at Constant FX in Q3 2026, down from 20% in Q2 2026, a change of -7 points. Asia Pacific was the main drag at 10%, an 11 point slowdown and 3 points below the group. Japan was the largest driver of the change, down 13 points, though it still grew 23%. Four of five regions grew, with Middle East & Africa at -7%. Jewellery Maisons led segments at 14%.
richemont.watch: Check whether Asia Pacific growth recovers toward the group rate and whether Middle East & Africa returns to growth against the easier base of 11.
